# GoldScalp AI: Phase 5.3 Validation Report

**Frozen pre-June historical validation of the Phase 5.2 shortlist.** Simulation only.

> Historical simulation on Vantage MT5 XAUUSD bid candles for January-May 2026: separate hypothetical $1,000 accounts per strategy, timeframe and month; no orders; no strategy changed. These results are reported **separately** and do not change any Phase 5.2 classification. The classes describe historical research candidates, **not trading readiness**. At least 30 trades is a minimum screen, not proof.

## 1. Protocol

- Definition `validation@1`; candidates locked from study `rb_7ca33b7b5a81`: `R2|v-d-Xb`, `R1|v-b-Xd`, `R5|v-d-Xd-tr`, `R7|v-c-Xe-tr`; benchmarks: their originals, unchanged.
- Months: V1 2026-01, V2 2026-02, V3 2026-03, V4 2026-04, V5 2026-05; data: `csv:vantage-mt5-xauusd-2026-jan-may` (research store); timeframes M5, M15.
- Same engine code, costs, lots and execution model as Phase 5.2; **no selection** - nothing is chosen, tuned or replaced on January-May.
- Criteria (Phase 5.2 thresholds; five-month rules made explicit): expectancy > 0; ≥ 30 trades; pooled PF ≥ 1.1 and PF > 1 in ≥ ceil(0.75 × months) (4 of 5); recovery ≥ 1; ≥ 4 of 5 months positive (a month with no trade counts as not positive) and positive without the best month; M15 > 0 as well as M5; still > 0 with spread + slippage ×2; at least 4 months with sufficient data.

## 7. The questions asked of each candidate

- **R2: Does it remain positive despite its negative October in Phase 5.2?** January-May: 273 trades, -0.054 R/trade (PF 0.79); Phase 5.2 out of sample 147 trades, +0.054 R/trade; Phase 5.2 October (secondary) -0.100 R/trade over 63 trades. Class: **rejected**.
- **R1: Does its small positive expectancy persist across another period?** January-May: 368 trades, +0.006 R/trade (PF 1.06); Phase 5.2 out of sample 258 trades, +0.026 R/trade. Class: **inconclusive**.
- **R5: Does its small positive expectancy persist across another period?** January-May: 222 trades, -0.053 R/trade (PF 0.86); Phase 5.2 out of sample 123 trades, +0.034 R/trade. Class: **rejected**.
- **R7: Does its unusually high expectancy survive a much larger sample?** January-May: 37 trades, -0.107 R/trade (PF 0.62); Phase 5.2 out of sample 21 trades, +0.400 R/trade. Class: **rejected**.
